product_metadata.title: Oubonun Rustic Tablecloth Cotton Linen Cloth Tablecloths Burlap Table Cloths for Kitchen Dining Cloth Table Cloth for Rectangle Tables Grey Plaids Rectangle Grey Stripe 55"x70"
features: Material and function: Oubonun tablecloth is made of cotton and linen, which is environment-friendly and natural. The tablecloths for rectangle tables is stain resistant, wrinkle free and easy to clean
Tassel edge design: The linen tablecloth with delicate embroidery patterns and beautiful fringe tassel makes the table cloths elegant. Embroidered simple pattern, cute fringe tassel pom-poms edge
Choose a tablecloth: Measure the size of the table, it is recommended to increase the table length by more than 20 inches (10 inches on one side) to get a better drop effect

More Occasions: As indoor table protector for dining room coffee table cover, kitchen table pads, as outdoor tablecloth for birthday party, wedding tablecloth, brunches, buffets, picnics, catering, restaurants, hotel, patio table and so on. Note: This is not a plastic tablecloth
Easy to clean: Machine washable in cold water with a gentle detergent, using a dryer or hung it to dry, tightly sewed tassel fringe will hold well after washing
